title: feat(mcp): support both v1 and v2 extension protocol in cdpRelay

target.summary: forwardToExtension unconditionally throws an error when sessionId is not provided, rejecting browser-level CDP commands. As a result, browser-scoped operations such as cookie management and state saving fail.
notes: faulty check throwing on missing sessionId instead of routing browser-level commands
definition of the method whose behavior is wrong
call site forwarding CDP commands without sessionId to the handler
